name: sdlc-agents
description: Six pipeline agents for the AI SDLC framework (spec-eval, tech-design, tech-design-eval, implementation, documentation, testing) for ServiceNow scripted REST, Kafka and .NET work. Each ends with a draft / ask_clarification / decline decision block; review steps add an approve / revise verdict. Designed to run under the orchestration-engine plugin's /sdlc conductor.
